items.title: Odamex – Doom
items.content:
Odamex is a Doom source port for Windows, Linux, and macOS that supports up to 255 players with client/server multiplayer and various game modes.

For PC. Runs on Linux, macOS, Windows. By Odamex Development Group.

items.title: TripleA
items.content:
TripleA is an open-source strategy game engine for Axis and Allies-style gameplay with community-created maps and an AI for single-player.

For PC. Runs on macOS, Windows. By triplea-game.

items.title: iortcw – Return to Castle Wolfenstein
items.content:
iortcw is a native PC port of Return to Castle Wolfenstein with SDL backend and OpenAL sound support.

For PC. Runs on Linux, macOS, Windows. By iortcw.

items.title: XA - Rust – Extreme Assault
items.content:
XA - Rust is a native Windows and Linux port of Extreme Assault, recompiled into Rust with a new runtime built on SDL3.

For PC. Runs on Linux, Windows. By retro gaming tools.

items.title: OpenDUNE – Dune II
items.content:
OpenDUNE is a native PC port of Dune II that allows the game to be run natively on most operating systems with enhancements like toggling FPS display and full screen.

For PC. Runs on macOS, Windows. By OpenDUNE.

items.title: Z - Rust
items.content:
Z - Rust is a native PC port of the game Z, recompiled into Rust with SDL3 support and a launcher.

For PC. Runs on Linux, Windows. By retro gaming tools.

items.title: FNF Mono Engine – Friday Night Funkin'
items.content:
A from-scratch C# / MonoGame port of the official Friday Night Funkin' (v0.8.1). Built to match the original game, running natively on Windows and Linux — with built-in support for Psych Engine and V-Slice mods as an extra.

For Xbox One. Runs on Linux, Windows. By Mohammad Aljafari.

items.title: Crash Nitro Komp – Crash Nitro Kart
items.content:
Crash Nitro Komp is a native PC port of Crash Nitro Kart for Windows, recompiled with Xbox XBE Recomp and featuring options for display, frame rate, and keyboard controls.

For Xbox. Runs on Windows. By goodthanksdev.

items.title: Captain-America-Super-Soldier-PC – Captain America: Super Soldier
items.content:
Captain America Super Soldier PC is a work in progress native PC port of the Xbox 360 game built using the ReXGlue SDK.

For Xbox 360. Runs on Windows. By bc160201983.

items.title: Call of Duty 2: Big Red One - XBE Recomp
items.content:
Call of Duty 2: Big Red One - XBE Recomp is a native PC port of the Xbox version of Call of Duty 2: Big Red One with modern controls, Q and E leaning, and high refresh rate gameplay.

For Xbox. Runs on Windows. By jbond2003.

items.title: ElonaFoobar
items.content:
elonafoobar is a C++ port of Elona derived from v1.22, featuring high extensibility through a mod system and localization.

For PC. Runs on macOS, Windows. By elonafoobar.

items.title: Playable3DMaze – 3D Maze
items.content:
Playable3DMaze is a port of the Windows 3D Maze screensaver that adds user controls and an overhead map toggle.

For PC. Runs on Windows. By x86matthew.

items.title: Battlefield Recompilation Project – Battlefield 1943
items.content:
Battlefield 1943 - Xbox 360 Recomp is a native PC port of Battlefield 1943 and Battlefield Bad Company with enhanced graphics, keyboard and mouse support, and multiplayer with bots.

For Xbox 360. Runs on macOS, Linux, Windows. By papand7.

items.title: Golgo 13
items.content:
Golgo 13 is a native arcade port of three Golgo 13 light-gun games for Windows and Linux, featuring statically recompiled game code and a French translation.

For Arcade. Runs on Linux, Windows. By naparuba-retro.

items.title: Toaru Majutsu Virtual On - recompilation – A Certain Magical Virtual-On
items.content:
Toaru Majutsu Virtual On is a Windows recompilation of the PlayStation 4 game A Certain Magical Virtual-On with menus, battles, story mode, movies, and sound working.

For PlayStation 4. Runs on Windows. By kitaaaaaa.

items.title: rottexpr – Rise of the Triad
items.content:
rottexpr is a PC port of Rise of the Triad that supports resolutions up to 3840x2160 and includes new gameplay options like ZomROTT mode.

For PC. Runs on Windows. By LTCHIPS.

items.title: sin-engine
items.content:
sin-engine is a PC port of SiN 1 Multiplayer built on the Quake II codebase with modernized SDL2 platform support and widescreen resolutions.

For PC. Runs on Windows. By shavargo.

items.title: NXEngine-evo – Cave Story
items.content:
NXEngine-evo is a port of Cave Story to PC with SDL2 support, widescreen, and animated character portraits.

For PC. Runs on Linux, macOS, Windows. By nxengine.

items.title: Postal 2 Reimplemented
items.content:
An open reimplementation of the POSTAL 2 engine in Rust and Bevy.

For PC. Runs on Windows. By p2HookedDev.

items.title: ezQuake
items.content:
ezQuake is a modern QuakeWorld client for Windows, Linux, and macOS that offers modern graphics and QuakeTV support.

For PC. Runs on Linux, macOS, Windows. By QW-Group.

items.title: Aliens vs Predator Tyrargo – Aliens vs Predator Classic
items.content:
Aliens vs Predator Tyrargo is a PC port of Aliens vs Predator Classic that improves input, audiovisual presentation, single-player systems and NPC behavior.

For PC. Runs on Windows. By Sol1vaN.

items.title: EC7Wolf – Corridor 7: Alien Invasion
items.content:
EC7Wolf is a source port of Corridor 7 Alien Invasion for Windows, Linux, and Android that runs the original game files natively.

For PC. Runs on Linux, Windows, Android. By jeddhor.

items.title: Redbound – Bounce Evolution
items.content:
Redbound is a source port of Bounce Evolution for Android, Linux, and Windows that runs the original game natively without emulation.

For Mobile. Runs on Android, Linux, Windows. By alox-dev.

items.title: Darkest Fear libgdx
items.content:
Darkest Fear libgdx is a port of the J2ME game Darkest Fear to Android, Linux, and Windows using the libGDX framework.

For Mobile. Runs on Android, Linux, Windows. By nitanmarcel.

items.title: DDHM-Recomp – Dangerous Dave in the Haunted Mansion
items.content:
DDHM-Recomp is a native Windows port of Dangerous Dave in the Haunted Mansion rebuilt in C++ without DOSBox.

For PC. Runs on Windows. By Syncr0ndi.

items.title: OpenFF3 Enhanced – Final Fantasy III (3D Remake)
items.content:
OpenFF3 Enhanced is a PC port of Final Fantasy III that adds turn-based battles, a customizable minimap, and upscaled textures.

For PC. Runs on Windows. By ausnick2001.

items.title: BOTWRecomp – The Legend of Zelda: Breath of the Wild
items.content:
BOTWRecomp is a native macOS port of The Legend of Zelda: Breath of the Wild built by static recompilation, translating game code to C and compiling it for Apple Silicon.

For Wii U. Runs on macOS. By vasist15-source.

items.title: Second Sight Recompiled
items.content:
Second Sight Recompiled is an unofficial fan-made PC port of Second Sight for Windows that offers modern display settings and controller support.

For GameCube, PC. Runs on Windows. By ThyHeroOfTime.

items.title: Zone of the Enders Recompiled
items.content:
Zone of the Enders Recompiled is a native PC port of Zone of the Enders for Windows and Linux with higher resolutions, widescreen, and Japanese voices.

For PlayStation 2. Runs on Linux, Windows. By almost-drowned-rat.

items.title: FearEffectRe – Fear Effect
items.content:
FearEffectRe is a static recompilation of Fear Effect for Windows that translates MIPS code to C++ for native execution.

For PlayStation. Runs on Windows. By thiagofmedeiros.

items.title: Heroes Lore: Zero - Native Multiplatform Recompilation
items.content:
Heroes Lore: Zero is a native C++17 port of the J2ME RPG Heroes Lore: Zero with modern controls and dynamic screen aspect ratios.

For PC, Mobile, Nintendo Switch. Runs on Windows, Android, Linux. By davidkalil10.

items.title: ReBusters 2nd – Beast Busters: Second Nightmare
items.content:
ReBusters 2nd is a native PC port of Beast Busters: Second Nightmare that allows play with mice, controllers, or PC light guns and supports up to three players.

For Arcade. Runs on Windows. By QuietClubGames.

items.title: Angry Birds PC engine (unofficial, C++) – Angry Birds Trilogy
items.content:
Angry Birds PC engine (unofficial, C++) is a port of Angry Birds that runs original Lua scripts and provides native functions for levels, menus, physics, and scoring.

For Mobile. Runs on Windows. By BurnerAccount-dec.

items.title: Heroes Lore: Wind of Soltia - Native Recompilation
items.content:
Heroes Lore: Wind of Soltia Native Recompilation is a C++17 port of the J2ME RPG for Windows, Linux, Android, and Nintendo Switch with real-time language switching and cloud save synchronization.

For Nintendo Switch, PC, Mobile. Runs on Windows, Android, Linux. By davidkalil10.

items.title: Abyssal – Deep 3D: Submarine Odyssey
items.content:
Abyssal is a PC port of the game DEEP that runs the original game engine in Godot with modern lighting and gamepad support.

For PC, Mobile. Runs on Android, Linux, macOS, Windows. By TheWWWorm.

items.title: Super Mario 3D Land Recompiled
items.content:
Native Windows x64 and Linux port built from a local European 3DS ROM.

For Nintendo 3DS. Runs on Windows, Linux. By Okxmir.

items.title: SyobonKZ – Syobon Action
items.content:
Syobon KZ is a cross-platform port of the unforgiving platformer Shobon Action.

For PC, Mobile. Runs on Android, macOS, Windows. By +KZ.

items.title: CorsixTH for Android – Theme Hospital
items.content:
CorsixTH for Android is a port of CorsixTH to Android for playing Theme Hospital.

For Mobile. Runs on Android. By alanwoolley.

items.title: Pinball Fantasies Native
items.content:
Pinball Fantasies Native is a reimplementation of the DOS game Pinball Fantasies for modern platforms with gamepad support.

For PC, Mobile. Runs on Linux, Windows, Android. By voobrazimoe.

items.title: Grief Syndrome (Android)
items.content:
Grief Syndrome (Android) is a port of Grief Syndrome for Android with touch controls, widescreen rendering and LAN co-op.

For Mobile. Runs on Android, Windows. By phys-winner.

items.title: pbfandroid – Pinball Fantasies
items.content:
pbfandroid is a decompilation and source port of Pinball Fantasies for Android with adjustable touch controls.

For Mobile. Runs on Android. By wootbeer.

items.title: mahoyo-steam-android-port – WITCH ON THE HOLY NIGHT
items.content:
An unofficial Android port of Mahoyo (WITCH ON THE HOLY NIGHT) Steam edition.

For PC. Runs on Android, Windows. By david419kr.

items.title: nanaca-crash – NANACA†CRASH!!
items.content:
nanaca-crash is a port of NANACA†CRASH!! to Windows and Linux, aiming for exact original gameplay including bugs.

For PC, Mobile. Runs on Linux, Windows. By Nyaldee.

items.title: lain-psx-decompiled-android – Serial Experiments Lain
items.content:
lain-psx-decompiled-android is a decompilation and native Android port of Serial Experiments Lain for PlayStation with touchscreen and gamepad support.

For PlayStation, Mobile. Runs on Android. By VandalsEmpire.

items.title: Provenance: Elite Force II decomp – Star Trek: Elite Force II
items.content:
Provenance: Elite Force II decomp is a native Android and Linux port of Star Trek: Voyager — Elite Force II with a Vulkan renderer and local-network multiplayer.

For PC. Runs on Android, Linux. By imjustadudegamer.

items.title: Klingon Honor Guard - Android – Star Trek: The Next Generation - Klingon Honor Guard
items.content:
Klingon Honor Guard - Android is a native Android port of the Unreal Engine 1 first-person shooter with a Vulkan renderer and on-device FMV cutscenes.

For Mobile. Runs on Android. By imjustadudegamer.

items.title: rott94 – Rise of the Triad
items.content:
Rott94 is a PC port of Rise of the Triad that emulates keyboard controls with touch input.

For PC. Runs on Windows, Android. By h4mu.

items.title: VoyagerSP-Android – Star Trek: Voyager - Elite Force
items.content:
VoyagerSP-Android is a native Android port of Star Trek: Voyager - Elite Force single-player campaign with touch controls and gamepad support.

For Mobile. Runs on Android, Linux. By imjustadudegamer.

items.title: CR3-U – Chaos Rings III
items.content:
CR3-U is a native port of Chaos Rings III for Windows, macOS, Linux, Android and iPhone/iPad that runs from your own game files.

For Mobile, PC, PlayStation Portable. Runs on Android, Linux, macOS, Windows, iOS. By DuIslingr.

items.title: VoyagerHM-Android – Star Trek: Voyager - Elite Force
items.content:
VoyagerHM-Android is a native Android port of Star Trek: Voyager - Elite Force Holomatch with a Vulkan renderer and JIT recompilers for improved performance.

For Mobile. Runs on Android. By imjustadudegamer.
